The '''Pain Factory''' was an installation of [[House Ulgo]] located in the [[Alsakan Lowlands]] on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. Around [[3643 BBY]], the Ulgos conducted experiments on [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]] within the facility.
